title: Protocol 18 upgrade ledger: header at 18 but trades still report CLAIM_ATOM_TYPE_V0 atoms
why: Protocol 18 (CAP-38) added liquidity-pool claim atoms, yet on its upgrade ledger the nine trades still report CLAIM_ATOM_TYPE_V0 atoms (seller as a raw ed25519 key) and none of the newer ORDER_BOOK or LIQUIDITY_POOL arms, because the transactions ran under Protocol 17. Readers that expect the newer atoms from the header version mis-decode the results.

variants.notes: Real pubnet ledger; header protocol 18, transactions applied under Protocol 17.

values.note: CLAIM_ATOM_TYPE_V0: the seller is a raw key, not an AccountID.

notes: 796 transactions; the 9 claim atoms of the ledger are all v0 (results of apply indexes 5, 16, 17, 785, 788 and 792). The focus, apply index 5, is a manage_sell_offer whose one claimed atom has amount_sold and amount_bought 0: the offer 835119339 of GBTKD5WR… (seller_ed25519 66a1f6d1…) is touched without value moving. Participants are the source and fee payer GCAGL62P…, the operation source GCVU42UV… and the offer owner GBTKD5WR…, all of whose entries changed. The lake object was written by stellar-core 23.0.1 long after the ledger closed (source.regenerated true), so its TransactionMeta is v4 with backfilled classic and fee events, not what a node emitted at the time.
